Existing adapter emitted accepted/delta/completed/cancelled, so retry UI required a separately paired legacy harness. Retained StoredTurn and MessageHistory already implement failed-attempt retry lineage and fresh request identity.

implementation: An explicit service prompt-prefix requirement preserves the legacy loopback constraint and permits ordinary offline frontend input

Cancel wins over the scheduled fixture failure; stale ticks after terminal produce no events
Existing draft/history limit of16384 UTF8 bytes is checked before submission; rejected input remains in the editor
